Subject: Candidate update + draft offer for Emily Zhang (RC: EMZ-4821)

Hi Dylan and Laura,

Quick update on Emily Zhang (ACME Robotics). She's excited and confirmed she wants to move forward contingent on comp/level alignment. Attached is the draft offer package the recruiting team prepared (base + equity + sign-on). The initial recommendation from recruiting is L5 Manager, but hiring manager had signaled senior IC could be appropriate depending on scope.

Key facts:
- Candidate: Emily Zhang — Staff SWE at ACME Robotics, IC lead of perception infra, 8 yrs total
- Hiring manager: Priya Natarajan (copied in Greenhouse) — prefers L5 Manager to support a direct report hire and ownership of roadmap
- Recruiter note: Candidate has some org leadership experience but prefers IC-heavy role; will consider manager if promoted title and career path are clear

Attached: offer-matrix-2026Q4.pdf (proposed comps by level), comp-comparator-EMZ.xlsx (benchmarked against similar hires in Q3).

Ask: Can you weigh in on whether we should proceed with L5 Manager as drafted, or extend an L5 Senior IC offer with a clear path to manager after 6–9 months (and what that would change in comp)? If it's easier, a quick call today would help — Emily is hoping for resolution before EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Sara Huang
Senior Recruiter, HireWell
(sara@hirewell.io)

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sara@hirewell.io
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate update + draft offer for Emily Zhang (RC: EMZ-4821)

Laura —

Thanks for the packet, Sara. I'm leaning toward offering the L5 Manager title when we close — two reasons: 1) Priya needs someone who can own a small team and mentor a mid-level engineer we've prioritized hiring; 2) having manager in title materially helps the candidate's leadership credibility in client conversations (ACME is customer-facing).

However, I want to avoid over-indexing on title if the candidate truly wants IC work. Proposed compromise option:
- Offer L5 Manager with baseline comp in the attached matrix (Tier A base + equity band 3).
- Add a 6-month check-in clause in the offer: if candidate stays and demonstrates impact on people/roadmap, immediate eligibility for band review and 10% mid-cycle merit uplift (accelerated promotion path).
- If candidate prefers IC, offer Senior IC (L5 IC) with identical comp but different bonus vesting schedule and a documented path to people manager in 6–9 months if they opt in.

Questions for GC/Comp: will identical comp for both titles create precedent issues? If so, we should price manager ~5% above IC (reflective of people responsibility). Also flag for Marissa: do we have budget headroom under HC-2026-0921?

I'll be on a call 1–2pm PST if you want to jump on brief talk.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Staff, Product Recruiting (acting hiring partner)
Redwood Inference

All —

Budget & comp notes after review: HC-2026-0921 has capacity for one L5 slot this quarter (confirmed with finance). We do not want to routinely compress manager/IC comp lines, but for this hire I approve equalized comp at the L5 range (base + target equity) under two conditions:
1) Offer must include the 6-month leadership review clause and an explicit hiring timeline for the direct report (Priya must provide a req number or hiring plan).
2) Candidate signs a short commitment to the leadership development plan (non-binding for promotion but confirms mutual expectation).

Suggested legal-friendly clause (short):
"At 6 months from your start date, Redwood will conduct a performance and role review. Based on demonstrated leadership and impact, the company may accelerate promotion or title change and adjust compensation accordingly."

Marissa approves moving forward with L5 Manager offer as drafted (equal comp to L5 IC) once Priya supplies the hiring plan. Please confirm and I will instruct HR to prepare the final offer packet and DocuSign link.

-Marissa Cole
